title: Claude Code Drops Its To-Do Tools on the Newest Models
caption:
I used to judge how well a session was going by watching the to-do list fill in.

2.1.233 took that away on Opus 4.8, Sonnet 5 and newer. Same feature they shipped in April 2025 to keep Claude "on track". No reason given in the changelog.

Honestly, I think I was reading that list for my own comfort, not because it made the code any better.

Do you miss it?

slides.headline:
Claude Code removed
the to-do list
slides.sub: Version 2.1.233, shipped Aug 14: the task-tracking tools are gone on the newest models.

slides.title: Five tools, gone
slides.sub: TaskCreate, TaskGet, TaskUpdate, TaskList and TodoWrite — all dropped in one changelog line.

slides.title: Only the new models
items: Opus 4.8, Sonnet 5, Fable 5, Mythos 5 and newer lose them
Older models keep their to-do list, unchanged
Set CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS=1 to bring them back

slides.title: The whole arc
items: Apr 30, 2025 — Claude gets a to-do list to “stay on track”
Aug 14, 2026 — the newest models don't get one
The changelog gives no reason for the change

slides.headline: Bring it back?
slides.sub: and I'll send the env var + the changelog
